title: Setting a part inactive asks to confirm and explains the effect
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. Set a part inactive (from a selection or the edit dialog).
  2. Read the confirmation: that it is the standard dialog with no field to type into, that the part will be hidden from operational lookup, and that historical records are not changed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Setting a part inactive shows a confirmation before it is applied - the application's standard dialog with no field to type into - stating that the part will be hidden from operational lookup and that historical records are not changed.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R1: “Setting a part inactive shows a confirmation before it is applied. It is the application's standard confirmation dialog, with no field to type into.”
  • S10-R2: “The confirmation states that the part will be hidden from operational lookup.”
  • S10-R3: “The confirmation states that historical records are not changed.”
